label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the SQL string q constructed by concatenating param (derived from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest')) into the UPDATE statement. Attacker-controlled input reaches the SQL syntax without sanitization or parameterization. Although execution is deferred to another method/component, the construction of the dynamic SQL string represents a confirmed vulnerability.

evidence.note: User input param is retrieved and directly concatenated into SQL string q without sanitization.
